title: Welcome! To My Decrepit Domicile
requirements: Mission must be active before gathering.
Pickaxes, Hatchets and Sickles; spare tools recommended.
steps: Bring spare Pickaxes, Hatchets and Sickles. With this mission active, mine in an original or Zilart area until you obtain the Sturdy metal strip key item.
Log in an original or Zilart area for the Piece of rugged tree bark; avoid Buburimu Peninsula for this objective. Harvest in an original or Zilart area for the Savory lamb roast key item.
You may collect all three before returning. Examine the Upper Jeuno H-8 door repeatedly to deliver the strip, bark and roast in that order, watching each scene.
These are gathering key items, including the roast; buying ordinary food does not fulfill the request.
notes: The items are random gathering results; several attempts or broken tools may be needed.

title: An Errand! The Professor's Price
requirements: At least one orb key item; all four strongly recommended.
steps: Farm Cardians for the four orb key items: Swords, Cups, Batons and Coins. Dahlia Tower, entered at West Sarutabaruta F-11, contains all four families.
Collecting all four on the initiating character removes the damage-type restrictions and reduces the encounter to five Custom Cardians. Each character needing credit should bring at least one orb.
Enter the separate Outer Horutoto section from East Sarutabaruta H-3. Examine the ??? on the Ancient Magical Gizmo opposite the entrance to start the confrontation.
Defeat every Custom Cardian without leaving the encounter area. The orbs are consumed; victory grants the Ripe starfruit.

Return to Shantotto in Windurst Walls K-7 and agree to pay 5,000 gil. Finish her follow-up dialogue, then examine the Inconspicuous Door in Upper Jeuno H-8 to advance and receive the treasure-search destination.
notes: The reviewed code and wiki disagree on the Cups/Batons damage mapping; gathering all four avoids relying on that disputed mapping.
reward: Ripe starfruit and Peach coral key.

title: Shock! Arrant Abuse of Authority
requirements: Access to chocobo riding/digging; Chocobo License for rental chocobos.
steps: Read the assigned digging zone in the Rent-a-Room scene. Bring plenty of Gysahl Greens and reach that zone on a chocobo.
Dig and use the direction and distance messages to narrow the search. Move toward the clue, dig again and repeat until you recover the Moldy, worm-eaten chest key item.
Stay in the assigned zone while searching: leaving can relocate the treasure.
Return to the Inconspicuous Door at H-8 for the delivery scene and the next assignment.
notes: The destination is assigned to your character; another player's digging coordinates need not work.

title: Lender Beware! Read the Fine Print
requirements: Sahagin Key access for the Ornamented Door.
Sneak and a return/escape method recommended.
steps: Prepare a Sahagin Key before taking the one-way Ornamented Door route. One party member can open it for the group.
From Sea Serpent Grotto C-8, pass through both Cracked Walls into the hidden room. Examine the Shady Sconce at the back; check again to finish the Moogle scene.
Go to the Ornamented Door at J-11 and use the Sahagin Key. Beyond it, follow the bridge to the Waterfall Basin at H-6 and examine the basin, not the nearby ???.
Return to the Inconspicuous Door in Upper Jeuno H-8 for the scene completing this mission.
notes: The Sahagin Key is consumed when opening the door; avoid accidentally leaving the required section before examining the basin.

title: Rescue! A Moogle's Labor of Love
requirements: Map of the Quicksand Caves to follow the assigned markers.
Sufficient player weight to open the weight doors. The later-retail Loadstone shortcut is an option only if available on Zenith.
steps: Enter Quicksand Caves through the hidden Western Altepa Desert D-12 entrance and speak to the Goblin Geologist at J-11.
Use your map markers to find the nine assigned ??? sites. Examine each for a stone; track the ones collected because markers may remain visible.
Other marked sections may require the Western Altepa G-5/J-9 or Eastern Altepa H-10/K-7 entrances. Collect Surya, Chandra, Mangala, Budha, Brihaspati, Shukra, Shani, Rahu and Ketu.
Return all nine key items to the geologist for the Navaratna Talisman.
From the geologist's section, pass the I-9 and H-7 weight doors, drop down and head toward D-4 to reach the Chamber of Oracles. Examine the Shimmering Circle for the story scene.
notes: Trusts do not substitute for player weight on the standard weight-door route. Stone sites themselves are not behind those doors.

title: Roar! A Cat Burglar Bares Her Fangs
steps: After the introductory scene, examine the Shimmering Circle again with the Navaratna Talisman to enter the battlefield.
Control the three Goblin attendants while focusing on Nanaa Mihgo. Sleep can control the Goblins in the reference encounter.
Prepare for Nanaa to call Bopa Greso and Cha Lebagta during the battle. Keep vulnerable party members out of her frontal attacks and maintain status-removal support.
Defeat Nanaa to win, then watch the concluding scene and return to Upper Jeuno.
reward: Red coral key and story progression.

title: A Challenge! You Could Be a Winner
requirements: Sneak/Invisibility consumables for the level-1 timed gauntlet.
steps: Examine the Shadowy Pillar near Switchstix. Travel to Beaucedine Glacier and examine the Lonely Evergreen at G-7, then speak to the Goblin Grenadier near H-8/H-9 with a Map of the Northlands.

Inspect the six marked Pips and note their elements. Connect horizontally or vertically adjacent pips whose elements are consecutive weekdays: Fire → Earth → Water → Wind → Ice → Lightning → Light → Dark → Fire. The lines form a digit. Report that digit to the Grenadier; take the Pocket mogbomb to the Lonely Evergreen for the Trivia challenge kupon.

In Xarcabard, examine Option One (G-8/H-8), Option Two (G-9) or Option Three (G-8). Answer three questions correctly, using your character's displayed statistics when requested, to obtain the Gauntlet challenge kupon.

Return to the Baileys Shadowy Pillar for the level-1 gauntlet. Reach the Flame of Fate by the Keep approach within eight minutes for the Festival souvenir kupon. Your initial stealth can expire sooner; bring Sneak/Invisibility items.
In Castle Zvahl Keep, examine the Ominous Pillar, then search the Craggy Pillars along the teleporter route for the Slacker Moogle. Obtain the Mega Bonanza kupon.
Continue to the Throne Room and examine its door for the final introductory scene.
reward: Mega Bonanza kupon and final battlefield access.

title: Smash! A Malevolent Menace
requirements: Prepared level-75 party; Zenith Trust entry and solo balance unconfirmed.
steps: Examine the door after the introductory scene and use the Mega Bonanza kupon to enter the final battlefield.
Fight Riko Kupenreich with healers separated from his frontal bomb attacks and the party prepared for wide-area stun and terror.

During the first two add phases, Riko retreats to recover while five Black Mage Henchman Moogles attack. Defeat those adds and resume damage when he returns; the White Mage attendants at the throne cannot be targeted.
In the final add phase Riko remains active. Control the new attackers and finish Riko, then watch the victory scene.
reward: Angel skin key and Oxblood key; title: Mog House Handyperson.
